# Yukos Mechanical

> Yukos Mechanical is a 22+ year HVAC expert serving the Tri-State area (NY, NJ, CT) with residential and commercial heating, cooling, and maintenance solutions.

Founded in 2003, Yukos Mechanical specializes in HVAC installation, repair, and maintenance across Rockland County, Westchester, and the greater New York metropolitan region. The company features expertise in modern systems including Mitsubishi and Navien equipment, VRF technology, and emergency heating services.
